restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.text: For life-threatening food allergies triggered by cross-contact, the restaurant may not be appropriate because avoidance of cross-contact cannot be guaranteed with 100% certainty.
Guests should tell the server about allergy or dietary concerns; the restaurant will help select a dish rather than remove an allergen from a dish.

summary: Founding Farmers DC is confirmed at 1924 Pennsylvania Avenue NW. The current location-specific breakfast/brunch, lunch/dinner, dessert, and America 250 menu PDFs contain 137 unique food/nonalcoholic products, and every frozen row reconciles exactly. Four required searches found no formal item-level allergen matrix; direct menu ingredient positives and the official cross-contact warning are preserved conservatively.
